visualBrief.coreEventZh: Ajin 输入法的几轮红合同被集中治绿，但对外交付动作被刻意压住，留下红转绿、但未真正落盘的收口节奏。
visualBrief.primarySubjectZh: 在工坊里逐份翻看、核对、并加盖完工印记的契约工匠
visualBrief.keyActionZh: 用墨笔把红色契约划为绿色、把待交付的匣子封好却不发运
visualBrief.resultZh: 桌上几份红契约已翻绿，匣子完整合盖尚未启运
visualBrief.tensionZh: 线上引擎仍在运转，可日志纸卷已两个月未续
visualBrief.industrialMetaphorZh: 契约工匠对照红绿印章逐份核对，把契约治绿却不让匣子出厂
supportingSymbolsZh: 手持红绿印章核对契约的工匠
完整合盖、尚未启运的密封匣子
搁置已久、尘埃未动的旧日志卷轴
visualBrief.sceneDescriptionZh: 19 世纪工坊的一角，晨光从高窗斜照进来，工匠站在橡木长案前，案上摊着几份契约，旁边放着封好的木匣，背景里只剩一卷积灰的旧日志静静立在架上。
focalElementsEn: a craftsman in an apron stamping contracts at a long oak workbench
a sealed wooden chest with its lid latched and untouched
a dusty log scroll left idle on a background shelf
visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A 19th-century workshop, morning light slanting from a tall window. At center, a craftsman in a leather apron stands at a long oak workbench, pressing a green stamp onto red-bordered contracts spread before him. To his right, a wooden chest sits sealed, its lid latched and clasp fastened, never opened. In the dim background, a single dusty log scroll rests motionless on a high shelf.
